title: Conditions: Byte decides
reflection: MINE changed the challenge every time, but your programs still worked. How did Byte know what to do?

steps.goal: Every time your program starts, MINE builds a wall in front of Byte, at a different distance. Write a program that climbs over the wall and lands right behind it.
steps.not_yet: Not yet: Byte has to land right behind the wall, back on the ground, without breaking it.
hints: byte.detect() is true when there is a block in front of Byte. while not byte.detect() do ... end repeats until Byte touches the wall.
When the loop ends, Byte is touching the wall: go up, forward twice, then down.
block_hints: The "block in front?" block is true when there is a block in front of Byte. Put "not block in front?" in "repeat while": it repeats until Byte touches the wall.
When the loop ends, Byte is touching the wall: "move up", "move forward" twice, then "move down".

steps.goal: Now MINE lays a row of 8 blocks in front of Byte: stone, with some gold in different places every time. Dig up only the gold, and leave the stone.
steps.not_yet: Not yet: dig up all the gold in the row, and none of the stone.
hints: MINE has put a gold block in the highlighted slot: byte.compareDown() is true when the block below is the same as that one.
Go up one block, then 8 times: move forward, and if byte.compareDown() then dig with byte.digDown().
block_hints: MINE has put a gold block in the highlighted slot: "block below same as the slot's?" is true when the block below is gold too.
"move up", then "repeat 8 times": "move forward", and an "if" with "block below same as the slot's?" that does "dig below".

steps.goal: MINE has put some blocks in the highlighted slot. How many? It doesn't matter! Build a tower in front of Byte with all of them, then bring Byte back to the ground.
steps.not_yet: Not yet: the tower must use all the blocks in the highlighted slot, and Byte must come back to the ground.
hints: byte.place() is false when it can't place a block, for example when the slot is empty. while byte.place() do byte.up() end builds until the blocks run out.
byte.down() is false when Byte touches the ground. while byte.down() do end brings it all the way down.
block_hints: The "blocks in the slot" block says how many blocks are left. Use "repeat while" with "blocks in the slot > 0" (the compare block is in Logic): "place a block in front", "move up".
Then "repeat until" with "block below?": "move down". Byte stops when it touches the ground.
